text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Repeating each and every day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wake up in the morning. Wash face. Get 
dressed. Leave the house immediately.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I head to the hospital. I nod politely to 
the nurses and the attending doctor.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I open the door to the hospital room. And 
take a quiet, deep breath.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The days repeat. —K.S.Miracle does not 
wake today, either.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ah... Miracle's Trainer!!
choice_data_list:
You all... You came again today, didn't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Right, me, Zephyr, Helios, and... Oh, 
we've got one more person today!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
My arm hurts, Helios-san. Could you please 
not cling to me so tightly?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
No, but still! If I don't hold on, 
milady's gonna try and bolt right away, 
right?!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...I am not running away. It is simply 
that I have... a mission I must fulfill—"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
..................... ......Regarding 
Miracle-san... My heart truly... aches for 
her.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Mira-Trainer! Um... How's this 
Miracle, huh?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Would you mind telling me a bit more 
about your situation?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just the other day, I had a long talk with 
her attending physician. I decided to open 
up to everyone about K.S. Miracle's 
current condition.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Brain waves are normal. Breathing is 
unassisted. They examined every inch of 
her body, but couldn't find anything 
resembling an abnormality.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To put it simply, she was in "good 
health," but... she never regained 
consciousness.

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
It's embarrassing to admit, but... I 
cannot say anything with certainty. 
However, when it comes to the "Umamusume"—

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
Um, the state of one's mind... or perhaps 
what should be called the 'soul,' can 
sometimes have a tremendous impact on the 
body.

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text: Therefore, in K.S. Miracle's case—
choice_data_list:
...The feeling that "it's now or never," 
that "this is the only place."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The thought that shattered me was... I'm 
running the fastest I ever have "right 
now," so if I don't win the Sprinters 
Stakes now, then when...?
choice_data_list:
Her heart was shattered... maybe that's 
why she won't wake up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even Daitaku Helios fell silent. Even the 
sun that was always bright grew dim, and a 
heavy atmosphere hung in the air.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Yet, at that moment—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Considering when your peak would be, 
it's 'now or never.'

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
If you seek the title of the fastest, 
"there is only the Sprinters Stakes."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Did she truly say that?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby asked me that. In an eerily 
calm... or perhaps, far too quiet voice.
choice_data_list: Ah, yeah... That's what they said.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for speaking with us. 
Now, if you will excuse us, we shall take 
our leave.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what!? H-Hold on, Milady!? By 'all 
of us', you mean us too!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wait, wait, wait!! Milady, please~~~!?!?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Miss Ruby! Um, is something the matter...?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, that surprised me! ...You don't 
usually do stuff like this, right? Like 
dragging us into it and all.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I know, right~~~!?!? Milady, what's 
wrong!? Ah, does your tummy hurt!? Lemme 
rub it—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Ms. Helios.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Pyaaah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Bamboo-san, Zephyr-san too.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —I have a request for all of you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Today, the cycle repeats once more. 
Wake up in the morning, wash my face, tidy 
myself up, and leave the house 
immediately.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Head to the hospital, nod to the nurses 
and attending doctor. Open the door to the 
hospital room, and—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Miracle... Miracle, wake uuuup...!! 
Sending telepathic waaaaves...!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Looking good, Helios...! That's prob the 
max volume allowed in a hospital room...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Then, I will too...! Miracle-san... 
telepaaaathy~~~~...!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Miracle's Trainer! Good morning to 
ya!! ...Oops, gotta keep my voice down...!
choice_data_list:
No... what's the deal so early in the 
morning...?

No... what's going on so early in the 
morning...?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I came to wake Miracle up! ...I'm 
definitely waking her up and taking her 
out with me!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course, I got the doctor's 
permission too, ya know! So I'm gonna give 
it my all. ...Since you asked me to!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. This is an earnest request from the 
Crimson Heavenly Wind—Ruby-san.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeppers!! ...The young lady actually asked 
us to help out~.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow, I will be holding an emergency 
press conference.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
If you need a venue prepared right away... 
I suppose my family's estate would do.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"I will follow up with the exact time 
later, but it will likely be around 
sunset."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Which is why she must absolutely be 
present at that press conference.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I would appreciate it if you could wake 
Miracle-san and bring her along.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Please, I earnestly ask of you. ...I look 
forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see. I'm not totally sure, but! 
I think ojousama—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
She looooves this! Seems like there's 
totally something she wants to tell 
Miracle!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: So with that, alright! Let's keep at it!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wake~ up~~~...! Miracle, Miracle, 
Mi~ra~cle~~~...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Miracle-san. ...Miracle-san. Please wake 
up, Miracle-san.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Miracle's Trainer, you too! Help 
us out, please!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together, we call out to K.S.Miracle. 
...Yet calling out like this is something 
we've done over and over... countless 
times before.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The faint hope that having her friends 
join in might change things gradually 
faded away... as time relentlessly marched 
on, second by second.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...This is bad. If I don't get out of the 
hospital soon, I won't make it to Ruby's 
family estate before sunset when the press 
conference starts...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
For now, how about we just get moving? If 
we keep waking her up while on the move, 
perhaps—!
choice_data_list: Alright, I'll get a taxi... Huh!?
Then I'll call a taxi... Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I gasp upon seeing the news notification 
on my phone. ...It looks like there was an 
accident on the road near the hospital. 
Traffic is completely jammed...!
choice_data_list:
Like this, I can't deliver any 
miracles...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I-I can carry this, no problem!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Like, I'll carry it, okay?! ...Ruby's 
waiting, for real!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! Handcart, check! Miracle, 
check! Miratrainer, check!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Alright then, let's go, let's goooo~~!!
choice_data_list: You plan on hauling us in this cart?!
You plan on hauling us in this cart?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"No... I thought it was completely 
reckless, but if we cut through the 
riverbeds and vacant lots... there 
actually might be a viable route, boss."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...I think I can do it! No, please let me 
go!! I'm counting on you, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
With time so precious right now, 
hesitation is an ill wind. Trainer, please 
ride with it. ...And above all, do not let 
go of Miracle-san.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hold them tight, and then call out their 
name plenty of times, okay?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeah yeah! And leave the traveling to us! 
Leave it to our legs~~~☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I'll take the lead and pull full throttle! 
Bambam and Zephyr-chi will push hard from 
behind!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
With an ultra-strong sprinter dream team 
formation...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Blow! 'Em! A-waaaay~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just when the car gave a massive jolt, a 
tremendous gust of wind enveloped my 
entire body. With a roaring sound, the 
scenery went flying backward.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahahahahahah!! Wait for me, 
Milady~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Definitely! Absolutely! I swear I'm taking 
Miracle!! With meeeeeeeeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Insane burst of speed as always, huh! 
But... like I'd ever let myself lose!! 
WOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll provide an even stronger 
tailwind!! Haaaaaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"This is why I think Umamusume are 
amazing. Because they possess 
one-of-a-kind legs."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Toward what I'm aiming for. Toward the 
future I want to seize. I have the legs to 
run at full power.
choice_data_list: ...The same goes for you too, Miracle!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I call out to K.S. Miracle, who remains 
asleep in my arms. Again, and again, and 
again.

text_block_list.name: Companions
text_block_list.text:
Ah ha ha ha ha ha!! Whoooooaaaaa!! 
Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The handcart jolts enough to bounce off 
the ground. The wind whips up pale 
light-blue hair, fluttering her ears.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: K.S.Miracle has not yet woken up.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hah... gasp... hah-hyu...!! Urgh...!! Even 
though... I'm so close...!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Kh, ugh...!! Huh? Uh-oh... my vision is 
going da--

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume's strides, which had grown 
steadily heavier, finally came to a 
complete halt.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The absolute limit of stamina. Just one 
look told me she had squeezed out every 
last drop for us.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just a little further until the house 
where Daiichi Ruby waits. ...The Umamusume 
had truly worked so hard.
choice_data_list: (In that case, it's my turn next!)
(In that case, it's my turn next!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Stepping down from the handcart, I carry 
the still-sleeping K.S.Miracle on my back. 
To keep her from falling, I use my 
taken-off jacket as a strap to tie her to 
me.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Haa, ngh... Trainer...? Do you really 
intend to carry me on your back the whole 
way...?!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nod back as firmly as I can. I don't 
have legs that can run forever. Nor do I 
have an unbreakable body or an 
extraordinary soul.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even so, they're human, too.
choice_data_list:
We're surprisingly tough ourselves, you 
know!

We're pretty tenacious ourselves, you 
know!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
...The young lady's waiting for ya. —I'm 
counting on you!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: G-Goooooo!! Miracle Traiiiiiin--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Her speed was on a completely different 
level compared to before. Even so, I run 
with all my might. I keep running. And as 
I run—I call out to her."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm out of breath in no time. Both my legs 
grow heavier and heavier, like lead. My 
pulse thumps so hard that even my vision 
throbs.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's brutal. My consciousness is fading. 
"Move your legs." "Keep calling out to 
her." My thoughts are reduced to simple, 
mechanical commands.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Blank)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Blank)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Blank)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: —Crimson.
